description: Stable resume URL pattern with version metadata. Place the canonical instance at /.well-known/resume.json (RFC 8615). Any tool can probe <host>/.well-known/resume.json for a portfolio's resume contract.

last_updated.description: Date-only (YYYY-MM-DD UTC) of latest regeneration. Date-only by design — full timestamps leak job-search activity.

preview_hash.description: Short hash of the preview PNG bytes. Decoupled from version_hash so metadata-only PDF updates don't bust preview cache.

preview_path.description: Repo-rooted public path of the page-1 preview PNG (#67). Optional — present only if rendering toolchain succeeded.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of resume.pdf for content addressing.

spec_version.description: SemVer version of this sidecar's schema contract.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the canonical resume PDF.

version_hash.description: Short version hash (first 8 chars of sha256). Use as ?v=<hash> cache-bust.

title: Resume Discovery Sidecar
